description:
Close or reduce your leveraged sBTC position. Agent-signed, no browser needed. Swaps sBTC to aeUSDC to repay debt, then withdraws remaining sBTC collateral. Backend sponsors gas.

Tip: call `earning_opportunities` to see how to put your assets to work.

minAeUsdcFromSwap.description: Min aeUSDC from swap (slippage protection, 6 decimals)

sbtcToSwap.description: sBTC to swap to aeUSDC for repayment (in sats)

sbtcToWithdraw.description: sBTC to withdraw after repayment (in sats)
